title: Retain finite provider spend and unknown reservations
problem: Worker reports may contain invalid amounts; appraisal comparison alone treats NaN as not over cap.
baseline: #156 stores raw worker cost and compares float(cost) to cap; mission accounting conservatively consumes the authorized cap.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Reuse #157 worker_spend normalization and reserve unknowns; retain current full-cap mission accounting.
advantages: No new evaluator, ledger or authority.
disadvantages: Historical standalone appraisals cannot establish canonical binding.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Reconcile all mission/authority spend changes from #157 at once.
advantages: Includes confinement and cognitive evidence adapters.
disadvantages: Settlement and interruption semantics need separate canonical integration evidence.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Independent cross-lineage parity and regression evidence.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Dedicated branch with tamper tests and signed test-key Body missions.
disadvantages: Does not qualify a real frontier provider.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Invalid worker amounts can be mistaken for acceptable spend; unknown cost has no explicit reservation evidence.
disadvantages: Independent appraisal is not bound to the work authorized.
